content_preview:
# 管道集成配置
# Pipeline Integration Configuration

triggers:
  # ETL完成后触发
  post_etl:
    enabled: true
    webhook_url: "http://localhost:8080/dq-audit"
    timeout_seconds: 300
    
  # 定时触发
  scheduled:
    enabled: true
    cron: "0 */6 * * *"  # 每6小时执行一次
    timezone: "Asia/Shanghai"
    
  # 数据变更触发
  on_change:
    enabled: false
    min_rows_changed: 100
    check_interval_minutes: 5

# CI/CD集成
ci_cd:
  quality_gate:
    enabled: true
    min_score: 80           # 质量门禁分数
    block_on_critical
